lines: While her Evil Eye was activated, it took away the kinetic energy of any object she touched, and reduced it to zero.
Bullets would suddenly stop on top of her skin, and even swords, no matter how masterful the wielder, would come to a halt the instant their tips touched her, without inflicting a single scratch.
And, she could even store this energy in her body and use it as her own power.
Her flung knives would accelerate like bullets, and she would even destroy boulders with a light punch.
――That was the Evil Eye ability of Fuuma Amane, steward of Danjou.
「All right, who wants to die next?!!」
Amane shouted, her entire body covered in blood.
There was no telling how many rogue ninja she had slaughtered now.
Amane's Evil Eye was that powerful.
However, even so, she was being slowly driven into a corner.
「She's at her limit now!! Surround her! Surround and kill!!!」
A rain of kunai descended from all directions.
Or in other cases, flames from Fire Escape blew toward her, or the earth and dirt turned into sharp spears and attacked her.
Gradually, the number of attacks that couldn't be completely absorbed by “Disruption Cycle” increased.
The injuries to her right foot and abdomen were also great.
Severe pain ran through her with every step she took. Before long, all feeling disappeared, and then――
Suddenly, the strength drained from her knees, and she almost tumbled to the ground.
At this point, it was too late to even activate “Disruption Cycle”.
“Then, here's where I'm going to”――Thinking that, Amane had bitten her lip firmly, when
For a moment, her conscious mind had gone blank due to the sudden event, before the meaning of that scene rapidly flowed into it.
In front of her eyes was a boy, dripping blood from his shoulder.
Fuuma Kotarou, the boy with whom she thought she had just parted ways.
He had put his body on the line to protect Amane, and kick away the owner of that dagger.
「Well...... Isn't it obvious?! I came to help.」
Despite grimacing from the pain in his shoulder, the boy faintly smiled at her.
「There's no way I could leave her alone...... after parting like that.」
Amane was shouting, driven by strong emotions that even she herself couldn't understand.
In fact, she had all but forgotten about this boy until they met again at that mansion――
「Help??! Don't screw around!! There's no way an incompetent like you can do anything, is there?!!」
「I can do a lot of stuff! Look――」
As if to overlap with the boy's words, pure-white smoke covered the area.
And then, confused voices from the Rogue Ninja Faction, who had stopped moving in their vigilance towards the intruder――
「......It's a Bedroom Art user's smoke bomb. The smoke has a strong illusionary effect, so please be sure not to inhale it.」
He must have detonated them all over the place before he jumped in to help.
Bedroom Art users had low combat ability, but they excelled at deceiving people using various crafty drugs and tools.
If it was smoke used by people like that, it was almost guaranteed to have some unpleasant effects.
Pulling the hand of Amane, who instantly held her breath, Kotarou disappeared into the smoke to hide.
「She can't get far with those wounds! Search for her!!」
Surrounded by smoke, the Rogue Ninja Faction were at the height of disarray.
All of a sudden, a small figure had jumped into the fight, and as soon as that happened, smoke filled the area.
They had lost sight of their prey.
That said, it didn't mean their superior position was shaken.
They had inflicted enough wounds upon her.
All that was left was to catch sight of her――
One of the ninja pierced the chest of the figure they had seen through the smoke――However.
A woman-shaped inflatable doll used for Bedroom Art training, which somebody had tied to a tree――And then.
The moment they stabbed their sword into that doll, a sticky liquid sprayed out with the leaking air, and struck the ninja.
「Cough cough! The impudence! A blinding attack?!!」
They coughed and made enraged shouts.
And it wasn't just one person.
The Rogue Ninja Faction were getting blinded by the inflatable dolls all over the place.
It was because they had breathed in the illusionary smoke.
Their perception was thrown out of whack, and they wound up easily falling for the crude “dummy” trap.
「Calm down, you idiots!! Don't be deceived by this child's play!!」
One of the ninja sharply rebuked them, to try and regain control.
However, before her eyes, a huge figure emerged through the smoke.
Everything from the ninja's neck up was blown away.
It was one of the animal Taimanin that guarded the Gosha mountains.

Not only was there grit for blinding them mixed into the liquid that had been sprayed from the inflatable dolls, but so too was an aphrodisiac for wildlife, which attracted animals for kilometres around and made them lose
The area had fallen into an uncontrollable state of confusion.
The rogue ninja were being attacked within the smoke by the frenzied animal Taimanin, or diminishing their own number by committing friendly fire out of panic.
「They're all tools that were in that mansion. When I heard Amane-san was being chased, I thought they might be useful for something――」
The huge baggage that Kotarou had been carrying when they escaped the hidden mansion.
He had packed not just the first-aid kit inside that, but even stuff like this.
Amane looked at Kotarou, who hid himself next to her, like she was seeing something unbelievable.
The boy had accepted that of himself, and yet he had still made a desperate effort to accomplish something.
All on his own, inside that dingy library.
As a result of that, he even had those powerful ninja twisted around his little finger, just through his wits and sagacity――
「.........I can do a lot of stuff too.」
The boy mutterred, as if to persuade himself.
「Well, I don't think I can be a replacement for my piece of shit old man, but...... I still do my best.」

“Don't just say you're going to die.”
Or was it, “Please go on living with me”?
Either set of words would be too heavy to be uttered by a boy who had nothing right now.
Something resembling a thin, jet-black spear pierced through Kotarou's abdomen.
「Hyo hyo hyo♪ Youngsters these days are pathetic, to be thrown into confusion by a plan this simple.」
The leader of the Fuuma Rogue Ninja Faction, Tekkain Bantetsu, had appeared through the smoke.
